cells: WGSLReflector.mapToGPUVertexFormat: private static mapToGPUVertexFormat(wgslType: string): GPUVertexFormat

Maps WGSL type strings securely to default GPUVertexFormats. NOTE: Packed formats (unorm8x4, snorm16x2, unorm10-10-10-2, etc.) CANNOT be reflected from WGSL because WGSL only sees the converted f32/i32/u32 result. If you are using packed formats in your JS buffers, you must manually override the format returned by this function. Body operations (including nested callbacks): calls to `wgslType.replace`; return paths including `'float32'`, `'float32x2'`, `'float32x3'`.
